concerns.text: T015 states: 'FIRST compute SD on the truncated series, THEN truncate to N=120'. This contradicts FR-010 ('calculate SD... using ONLY the time points remaining after motion scrubbing') and FR-011 ('subsample... to N=120... after motion scrubbing'). The task implies truncation happens BEFORE SD calculation, which would use a different set of time points than the scrubbed set, violating the semantic constraint of the spec.

T023a implements PCA to 200 components (FR-008). T023c immediately performs further feature selection (L1/RFE) to reduce to 20-50 features. T024/T025 then train models on 'Connectivity-only (using reduced features from T023c)'. This silently weakens FR-008 and SC-001/SC-002, which require a 'fair baseline comparison' against the 200-component baseline. The task list replaces the required baseline with a reduced subset without explicit spec authorization, violating the 'no silent constitution drift' principle.

T005b filters subjects based on a 'post-scrubbing simulation' before T013 (actual scrubbing) is implemented. FR-007 requires exclusion based on 'insufficient time points after motion scrubbing'. By simulating this before the actual scrubbing logic exists, the task creates a logical impossibility where the exclusion list cannot be accurate to the actual data processing defined in FR-012, violating the requirement for accurate exclusion logging.

T037b allows proceeding with an 'approximation' for the ΔAUC confidence interval if bootstrapping exceeds the time budget. SC-002 defines success strictly by the 'lower bound of the 95% CI'. An undefined approximation without a specified error margin or fallback success criterion makes SC-002 untestable and effectively weakens the success criterion, violating the 'no weakening of SCs' constraint.

T005b requires logging exclusions with headers 'subject_id, reason, fd_mean'. The spec (US-1 Edge Cases) defines the exclusion reason as 'insufficient time points' (a count). The task's header 'fd_mean' (a float) mismatches the spec's defined reason content, making the log untestable against the specific exclusion criteria in FR-007.
